decision.explanation: The provided evidence (pmid-27032107) describes a prospective phase II study evaluating first-line erlotinib in Caucasian patients with advanced lung adenocarcinoma carrying a somatic EGFR mutation. The study explicitly identifies the p.Leu858Arg (L858R) mutation as one of the somatic EGFR mutations present in the patient cohort (15 patients found with this specific mutation). The study concludes that erlotinib was 'highly effective in the majority of the patients' with these somatic EGFR mutations. This supports the claim that erlotinib demonstrates sensitivity/response in Lung Adenocarcinoma with somatic EGFR L858R. While the evidence is qualitative ('highly effective') rather than providing specific quantitative metrics isolated exclusively to the L858R subgroup, it sufficiently supports the direction and significance of the claim as written.
